description: The paper's text and its Table 1 disagree on two features. The text says 95 tumours showed necrosis, 59 with 1–33%, 27 with 34–66% and nine with more than 66%, and that 46 had a more than 50% exophytic component; Table 1 gives 57, 24 and 7 (88 in all, with 6 without necrosis and 9 missing) and 45. The text also gives necrosis agreement as alpha 0.429, Table 1 as 0.651. The released table matches Table 1.
inspectedScope: Paper Results and Table 1; the Necrosis and GrowthPattern columns of FullDataforAnalysis071714.csv.

evidence.locator: Results, Imaging features and Inter-observer agreement; Table 1
evidence.note: Concerns how the paper reports two features, not individual patients.

detection: Counts from the released table compared with the paper's text and Table 1.
impact: Figures quoted from the text do not match the data for necrosis and growth pattern.
handling: Take counts from the released table or Table 1, and say so when citing the text.

description: The table does not say which study or series the readers scored. TCIA's image list for this result holds 738 series in 118 studies; 79 patients have only CT series in it, 14 only MR and 10 both, while the paper reports CT for 81 patients, MRI for 19 and both for 3.
inspectedScope: The image manifest matched against the TCIA series list for TCGA-KIRC; paper, Patient cohort.

evidence.locator: Modality of each listed series, per patient
evidence.note: Patients with both CT and MR series in the image list; 11 patients also have more than one study in it (one has six).

detection: Series in the manifest looked up in the TCIA series list and grouped by patient and modality.
impact: A model trained on image–feature pairs may pair a feature with a scan the readers did not score.
handling: Choose one pre-surgical study per patient, state the rule used, and treat the pairing as approximate.

description: Neither the page nor the paper defines Status, Side, MultipleTumors, NumberLeftTumors or NumberRightTumors, or gives the reference date of DaystoLastFollowup. The tumour columns do not agree with each other: MultipleTumors is TRUE for 4 patients, but the two count columns give two or more tumours for 8 patients marked FALSE.
inspectedScope: All 23 columns of FullDataforAnalysis071714.csv; the analysis-result page and the paper.

evidence.note: Patients marked MultipleTumors FALSE whose left and right counts add to two or more ("> 3" counted as more than three).

detection: Profiled the columns and compared them with the paper's feature set.
impact: These columns cannot be used as labels without guessing their meaning.
handling: Use only the features the paper defines; ask the provider before using the others.

description: The 2017 application had no options for image quality, lesion location or lesion characteristics, "requiring additional post-collection image review". The anatomy column marks the source collection (Renal for every TCGA-KIRC row), not the measured lesion, so a measurement on a kidney-collection scan need not be of the kidney tumour. No result of the later review is part of this release.
inspectedScope: Crowds-Cure-2018 summary; the anatomy column against the TCGA-KIRC patient list.

evidence.note: Every kidney measurement lacks a lesion location.

detection: Stated by the provider on the Crowds-Cure-2018 page; the anatomy values were checked against the collections.
impact: Using the lines as kidney-tumour labels can include other lesions.
handling: Check the measured slice before using a measurement as a kidney-tumour label.

description: The structured-report ZIP holds 2,334 files for the 2,345 measurements in the CSV. 1,270 of the files name a TCGA-KIRC patient, against 1,282 kidney rows, so the two formats do not hold the same measurements.
inspectedScope: File list of CrowdsCureCancer-dicomsrfiles_20180830.zip and the TCGA barcodes in each file; the CSV.

evidence.note: Difference between kidney rows and report files that name a TCGA-KIRC patient.

detection: Counted the .dcm files and searched each for TCGA barcodes.
impact: A pipeline that reads only the structured reports misses some measurements.
handling: Use the CSV as the complete list of measurements.
